gmcm.default-crafting-amount.name: Default cooking/inventory amount
gmcm.default-crafting-amount.desc: Default amount when pressing Modifier + RightClick in Cooking / Inventory
gmcm.default-shop-amount.name: Default shop amount
gmcm.default-shop-amount.desc: Default amount when pressing Modifier + RightClick in a Shop menu
gmcm.modifier-key.name: Modifier key
gmcm.modifier-key.desc: Hold this key and RightClick to open the split input
gmcm.debug-mode.name: Enable debug mode
gmcm.input-box-position.name: Input box position
gmcm.input-box-position.desc: Adjust where the input box appears relative to the mouse cursor
gmcm.offset-x.name: Horizontal offset (X)
gmcm.offset-x.desc: Positive = right, negative = left. Offset from mouse cursor position (pixels)
gmcm.offset-y.name: Vertical offset (Y)
gmcm.offset-y.desc: Positive = down, negative = up. Offset from mouse cursor position (pixels)
gmcm.generic-menus.name: Support other mods' menus
gmcm.generic-menus.desc: Automatically apply stack splitting to inventory menus added by other mods (chests, fridges, storage and similar). Turn this off if a menu from another mod misbehaves with this mod installed.
gmcm.show-cannot-split.name: Show "can't split" hint
gmcm.show-cannot-split.desc: Show a hint near the mouse cursor when you try to split an item the game does not allow to be split (wallpaper, furniture, tools, a single item, ...).
gmcm.cannot-split-message.name: "Can't split" hint text
gmcm.cannot-split-message.desc: Text shown by that hint. Leave empty to use the built-in message.
gmcm.hint-duration.name: Hint display time (seconds)
gmcm.hint-duration.desc: How long the hint stays on screen, in seconds.
gmcm.hint-offset-x.name: Hint position offset (X)
gmcm.hint-offset-x.desc: Horizontal offset of the hint from the mouse cursor, in pixels (positive = right).
gmcm.hint-offset-y.name: Hint position offset (Y)
gmcm.hint-offset-y.desc: Vertical offset of the hint from the mouse cursor, in pixels (positive = down). The hint is shown above the cursor by default.
gmcm.hint-text-scale.name: Hint text size (%)
gmcm.hint-text-scale.desc: Font size of the hint, as a percentage of the game's small font.
gmcm.hint-outline.name: Hint outline thickness
gmcm.hint-outline.desc: Thickness of the black outline around the hint text, in pixels (0 = no outline).
gmcm.hint-shadow.name: Hint text shadow strength (%)
gmcm.hint-shadow.desc: Strength of the drop shadow behind the hint text (0 = no shadow).
gmcm.hint-color.name: Hint text colour
gmcm.hint-color.desc: Hex colour such as #FFFFFF or #FFD966. Leave empty for white.
